drop: Drop an EPUB, MOBI, AZW3 or FB2 book here
privacy: Your book stays in this browser. No uploads or remote resources.
invalid: This book is damaged or its content could not be read. Save a new, unencrypted copy from the original reading application.
failed: The exported HTML could not be displayed completely. Its download is unavailable. Try another browser.
unsupported: Choose a local EPUB, MOBI, AZW, AZW3, PRC, FB2, FBZ or FB2.ZIP book.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page or try a current browser.
fidelity: Export a local ebook as standalone HTML or UTF-8 plain text. Reading order, chapter text and available supporting sections are retained. Nothing is uploaded.
limitations: DRM-protected, fixed-layout and unsupported books cannot be converted. This is a readable content copy; original pagination, publisher styles, scripts, forms, audio, video and remote resources are not reproduced.
layoutNotice: HTML keeps readable structure, internal links and supported included images. Text keeps readable content and chapter order without images or formatting. External links open only when selected.
missingReference: This internal reference could not be found in the document.
protected: This book is encrypted or protected. The converter cannot remove DRM or open password-protected archives. Use an unencrypted copy that you can read.
incomplete: A required chapter is missing or unreadable. No shortened book is available for download. Save a complete copy and try again.
styleNotice: This copy uses a simple reading layout. Publisher styles, original page numbers and active content are omitted.
copyFailed: The text could not be copied. Select it manually or download the TXT file.
plainNotice: Plain text keeps readable chapter content and supporting sections. Images and formatting are omitted; safe external link addresses are included after their text.
emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose a book with content.
empty: This book contains no readable chapters.
resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while opening this document. Close other tabs and try again.
unsupportedLayout: This book uses a fixed or mixed page layout that cannot be exported reliably. Choose a reflowable book.
unsupportedVariant: This book format or compression variant is not supported. KFX and unrelated PRC files cannot be converted.
encoding: The book text encoding is unsupported or damaged. Save a UTF-8 copy when possible.
noBook: This archive contains no FB2 book.
ambiguous: This archive contains more than one FB2 book. Extract the book you want and open it directly.
missingResources: Some resources are missing or unsupported. Available text and images are retained, and unavailable images are marked.
imageUnavailable: This image is missing or cannot be displayed.
safePreview: Scripts and remote resources are not run or fetched. External links open only when selected.
unresolvedLinks: Some internal references could not be resolved. Their link text is retained.
